title: 架空旧埠·机械神秘
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept image edit.
TWO INPUTS, WITH DIFFERENT ROLES:
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the wide rainy old river harbor, stone stairways at left, moored working barge at right, a person on the landing, warm warehouse interiors, immense river and distant steamship silhouettes.
Image 2 is ONLY A MATERIAL / FORM / MOOD REFERENCE: a close-up of an enigmatic mechanical figure with a smooth ivory faceplate, black shell-like surfaces, fine dark metallic mechanisms, ceramic segments, cables and layered cloth. Ignore every written mark, religious/cultural identifier, screenshot border, app control, number, watermark and social-media graphic in this reference. Do NOT reproduce the screenshot or its costume literally.

Create ONE new full-frame wide landscape revision of Image 1: an ORIGINAL FICTIONAL RIVER HARBOR with an enigmatic mechanical aesthetic. Keep its excellent wet stone stairways, old layered warehouses, human eye-height camera, open river breathing space, moored boat, and muted blue-grey / warm amber noir light. Preserve the hand-inked comic rendering, dimensional environmental forms, rich selective painted textures, and integrated 2D character aesthetic. It should feel like a place in a playable comic world, mysterious and inhabitable, rather than a photoreal character portrait. No geographical or corporate identity anywhere.

CRITICAL ABSOLUTE REQUIREMENT: THE FINAL IMAGE HAS ZERO TEXT OR WRITING, ANYWHERE. Remove ALL existing Chinese writing on the huge near-left wall, all hanging vertical signs and banners, all shop and warehouse labels, both markings on the tower, all boat names, all flag lettering, all distant labels. Replace those surfaces naturally with blank weathered masonry, unmarked wood panels or plain cloth, leaving NO ghost lettering. Remove ALL clock numerals and dial marks: replace the tower clock with a single unmarked recessed ivory mechanical lens/disc. No letters, digits, pseudo-writing, fictional script, runes, seals, logos, insignia, watermarks, captions or UI. Plain abstract geometry may be part of the physical machine, never writing. All fabrics are unmarked.

The new visual language is precise, strange and quiet: smooth ivory porcelain plates suspended inside blackened metal frames, layered black enamel shells, slender bronze-colored rods, tightly organized cables, repeated small ceramic insulators, sparse dark vermilion cords and weathered pale fabric. Strong contrast between a few quiet smooth pale surfaces and carefully organized dark mechanical detail. A fictional ritual-like technology whose purpose is partly elusive. Do not tie it to any real religion, ethnic costume, organization or place. Do NOT use boiler-steampunk shorthand, giant decorative gears, pressure gauge clusters, brass wallpaper or top hats. Do NOT use neon cyberpunk, glowing magic runes, giant holograms or excessive fantasy architecture.

Apply the language coherently at THREE scales:
1. Replace the lone central red-jacket courier with a human-scale enigmatic mechanical harbor attendant in the SAME landing area and grounded pose. A simple elongated blank ivory faceplate with a narrow dark seam, black hood/coat silhouette, intricate but selectively visible neck/chest mechanisms, a few pale cloth layers and dark red cords. Keep the figure readable as a 2D illustrated character in the dimensional world, not a huge robot dominating the image. It is calm and watchful, not attacking.
2. Integrate a distinctive mechanical housing into the moored boat's near forward deck: a low tapered black shell with a smooth ivory insert, curved structural ribs, small ceramic segments and organized cables disappearing into the hull. Preserve the boat's working proportions and the walkable deck. A pale fabric cover gathered nearby and warm light in the cabin make the strange device part of everyday harbor life. No boiler or smokestack growing out of this device.
3. Introduce a few related devices built into the waterfront: one slender black-and-ivory assembly around an existing doorway and the tower's unmarked pale circular mechanism. A plain hanging dark cloth replaces the old lettered sign. Echo the same material language selectively along the boat fittings and doorway without coating every building in ornament. The old warehouses and river remain recognizable as the same environment.

Build mystery through the blank face, partially enclosed mechanism, repeated material language, veiled warm interiors, dark water reflections and restrained silhouettes. Let the stairs lead clearly toward the attendant and the boat. Retain useful empty space; mechanisms should be readable and purposeful-looking but slightly uncanny. The era is now fictional, so favor internal visual coherence over historical reconstruction.
Final sweep before output: every former sign, flag, wall, tower, clock face, boat panel and garment is free of ALL text, numerals, symbols resembling script, logos and real-world identifiers. Output only one wide image, same aspect ratio as Image 1.
review: Visual inspection: no visible lettering, numerals, logos or interface overlays; fictional mechanical motifs integrated into the harbor.
